correctness.rationale: For h>0, 0<w<4, the actual degree-nine source field in RESULT.md shears under z=y+w(x^2-h)x/(2h) to xdot=z+w(h-x^2)x/(2h), zdot=-x+w(h-2x^2-z^2)z/(2h). Thus q=(x^2+z^2)/h satisfies qdot=wq(1-q), giving global forward completeness for q0>0. The directional ratio u=z/x satisfies u_dot=-1-(w/2)q u-u^2, the Riccati equation for psi_ddot+(w/2)q(t)psi_dot+psi=0. The q-equation is Fuchsian, and the explicit q^(i/w)|1-q|^(1/4+i*sqrt(1-w^2/16)/w) hypergeometric F and conjugate solve it with nonzero Wronskian: near q=1 the time Wronskian is 2iΩ|1-q|^(1/2)(1+o(1)), and Abel propagates nonzero throughout each interval. Projective normalization uniquely recovers the physical (x,z) for both q<1 and q>1, including x=0 crossings. The stated coefficient A from (F,G) and Abar gives phase arg[A(|1-q|/q)^(iΩ/w)]; logistic c(t)=c0e^(-wt) proves exact phase drift -Ωt. The limit as q→1 agrees with the explicit circular phase arg[x+i(z+wx/4)/Ω] and O(e^(-wt)) phase-aligned convergence, showing whole punctured-plane isochrons. No assertion at origin, w=0, or w>=4. Fresh independent numerical integration of reduced original-time ODE and logistic radius corroborated to ~5e-12 across three w and nine starts; the actual source CHECK.py was inspected, not trusted as proof. The all-data conclusion follows from the analytic reconstruction, not bounded numerical tests.
